arguments.summary: Fixed `DiskCache.get` in `store/cache.py` to check TTL expiry: if the elapsed time since the entry's timestamp exceeds `self.ttl`, the file is removed from disk and the default value is returned (instead of returning stale data). Also cleaned up stale cache files (`old_1.json`, `old_2.json`) from the `cache/` directory, keeping only `keep.json` (fresh) and `README.txt`. All existing tests pass.
